content.comment_body: I notice that numeric values in the analog component are shown in gray text within a white box, making them difficult to see clearly. Is it possible to manually modify the text color by editing the code in [product_name]? ...sent from App
I'm not familiar with HTML or web programming. If changing the color is feasible, I might consider hiring someone to do it for me. ...sent from App
You can't do this with [product_name], but it might be possible using HTML5. However, I don't have experience with HTML5, so I'm unsure.

I encountered the same issue. It's particularly problematic with read-only values in AnalogValue fields, where the gray text on a gray background is very hard to read. A friend found a workaround—add certain lines to these locations: /css/edit.css (at the end), and in main.htm and main.html inside the <style> section within <HEAD> (after .textCenter and before </style>). Hope this helps; these changes should be default in [product_name]. Also, the forum question title could be clearer, for example: "[product_name]: AnalogValue fields hardly readable (gray text)."

analysis.insight_summary: Users note that numeric values in analog component fields of [product_name] are hard to read due to default gray text on white or gray backgrounds. Addressing the issue requires manual styling changes, creating a challenge for those without web development skills. There is general agreement that the current color scheme makes readability difficult, and users hope for more customization or improved defaults.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want numeric values in analog component fields to be easily visible and wish to have a straightforward way to adjust text color, preferably without needing coding experience.
